static_tool_contract_proposed_not_implem.UCI_metadata: Cross-check option declarations, handlers and a declared exposed-build option manifest. Compile-OFF/default build must retain canonical typed metadata with no new advertised dead option. Qualified expose-build runtime-OFF/ON declarations must include each declared new option with the documented default/type/range. Missing, duplicate, malformed or undeclared extra options fail.
static_tool_contract_proposed_not_implem.actual_application: Invoke Git apply --check and GNU patch -p1 -F0 dry/apply as argument arrays on separate fresh copies; save exit codes and raw streams, compare applied target inventories and ensure untouched-source identity. Disallow external diff tools/hooks/commands from patch or archive metadata.
static_tool_contract_proposed_not_implem.archive_safety: Enumerate ZIP metadata before any extraction, enforce explicit recorded limits for entry count, single expanded size, total expanded bytes and compression ratio. Reject encrypted, special/symlink entries, duplicate or case-fold-colliding names, absolute/traversal paths, nested archives unless separately bounded and declared. Stream extraction under NEW scratch; never use unrestricted extractall or run archive scripts. Limit breach is fail-closed with no source execution.
static_tool_contract_proposed_not_implem.archives_vs_delivery: The checker may inspect a user source ZIP; S27 itself is delivered as dated tool/tests/catalogue/report files, not a source ZIP. A source-tree archive is compared against explicitly declared immutable base content; do not treat it as trusted source merely because CRC passes.
static_tool_contract_proposed_not_implem.determinism: Stable sorted records/error ordering, logical relative paths, fixed fixture seed, no timestamps/random temporary names in comparable static result payload. Preserve original byte evidence separately from normalized projections.
static_tool_contract_proposed_not_implem.output_safety: Require a new output directory, no symlink, fail one-line/nonzero for existing output, all scratch/copy/apply/result writes under it. Never modify inputs, canonical L/L-prime/B, baseline, dist-v families, lock directories, caller resources or running processes. Snapshot before/after input manifests.
static_tool_contract_proposed_not_implem.patch_path_validation: Parse both old/new/header/rename paths before invoking tools. Reject absolute, drive/UNC, NUL, traversal, backslash ambiguity, symlink/gitlink modes, unsupported binary patches and any path escaping NEW scratch. Recognize /dev/null only as patch metadata. Reject forbidden baseline/dist-v/lock destinations and source/output aliasing.
static_tool_contract_proposed_not_implem.static_default_guard: Track lexical comment/string and preprocessor context conservatively; report unguarded added production storage/counters/work/output and setoption/advertise changes with path+line evidence. Unsupported dynamic/preprocessor reasoning cannot silently PASS. Catch all three known Job A leaks, not only the option line.
